<div id="abouten">
Hi, I'm Kira Wei 👋
I bridge the gap between data science, human behavior, and strategic profitability.

With a unique trajectory spanning a BS in Psychology, an MBA (Marketing & Pricing), and an MS in Data Science, I look at revenue management through a multidimensional lens. I don't just see numbers on a spreadsheet—I manage the business strategy and the data architecture needed to scale it.

🎯 What I Do
I specialize in Pricing Optimization and Revenue Management. I transform complex behavioral and financial datasets into predictive models and dynamic pricing strategies that maximize profitability without sacrificing customer trust.

Data Science: Predictive modeling, statistical analysis, causal inference.

Pricing Strategy: Value-based pricing, elasticity modeling, and market positioning.

When I’m not tuning revenue models or diving into Python, I am happily being managed by my two cats. 🐈‍⬛🐈

Let's connect! Feel free to reach out to discuss my articles and code-chat.
